Storypane **0.1.0-rc.15** is a release candidate for evaluation.

The **New folder** dialog shows **Example page URL** only when **URL folder** is selected. Choosing **Organizational folder** hides both the slug input and the URL panel. Switching back restores the URL preview with the entered folder name.

Install the CMS from source tag `v0.1.0-rc.15`. Install the SDK with
`npm install @storypane/sdk@0.1.0-rc.15` or follow `@storypane/sdk@rc`.

Back up databases, original media, configuration and keys before upgrading.
Upgrades from rc.14 use the existing folder storage. See the editor guide for how the two folder types affect page URLs.
